statements.markdown: **Proposition 8.1 (Stability of each fixed greedy prefix).** *Let $t_j\to1/2$ and, for each fixed $n\ge2$, let $v_n^{(j)}\to x_n=(2^n-1)^{-1}$, with $v_n^{(j)}>0$. Apply the greedy rule with target $t_j$ and weights $v_n^{(j)}$ in increasing order of $n$, through depths $m_j\to\infty$. For every fixed depth $K$, the decisions at ranks $2,\ldots,K$ eventually agree with those of the real half-greedy rule. This assertion concerns finite prefixes, not survival at all ranks.*
